parts: Create a website creation check list for client to give me so I can make her website

Here’s a **Website Creation Checklist** you can give to your client so you have all the details you need to build her website smoothly:  

---

# Website Creation Checklist for Client  

Please provide as much of the following information as possible so I can create your website exactly how you want it.  

### 1. Business Information  
- Business name  
- Tagline or slogan (if any)  
- Short business description (what you do, who you serve, what makes you unique)  
- Contact information (phone, email, address if applicable)  
- Hours of operation  

### 2. Branding & Design  
- Logo files (preferably PNG/SVG with transparent background)  
- Brand colors (hex codes or examples)  
- Brand fonts (if you have specific ones)  
- Style inspiration (modern, elegant, minimal, bold, feminine, luxury, etc.)  
- Example websites you like (2–3 links with what you like/dislike about them)  

### 3. Website Goals  
- Main purpose (informational, lead generation, booking, e-commerce, blog, portfolio, etc.)  
- Target audience (who you want to attract)  
- Primary action you want visitors to take (book, call, buy, fill form, subscribe, etc.)  

### 4. Pages Needed  
Please check which pages you’d like:  
- Home  
- About  
- Services / Treatments / Programs  
- Shop (if e-commerce)  
- Blog / Resources  
- Testimonials / Reviews  
- Gallery / Before & After photos  
- Contact / Booking  
- FAQ  
- Other: _____________________  

### 5. Content  
- Written text for each page (or notes if you want me to help write it)  
- Professional photos (team, services, products, space)  
- Stock photo preferences (style you like if you don’t have your own)  
- Videos (if you want to include any)  

### 6. Functionality  
- Online booking / scheduling (please provide your booking platform login if already using one)  
- Forms (contact, consultation request, newsletter signup, etc.)  
- E-commerce setup (products, descriptions, prices, payment methods)  
- Blog setup (yes/no)  
- Newsletter or email integration (Mailchimp, Klaviyo, etc.)  
- Social media links (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, etc.)  
- Chatbot/live chat (yes/no)  

### 7. Technical  
- Domain name (do you already have one? If yes, provide login details)  
- Website hosting (do you already have one? If yes, provide login details)  
- Platform preference (WordPress, Squarespace, Shopify, Wix, other)  
- Any integrations (CRM, booking software, payment processor, etc.)  

### 8. Legal & Policies  
- Privacy Policy (do you have one or need one created?)  
- Terms & Conditions (if selling products or services online)  
- Consent forms (if applicable for services)  

### 9. Timeline & Budget  
- Desired launch date  
- Any deadlines tied to events, promotions, or launches  
- Budget range (if not already agreed upon)  

### 10. Extras  
- Do you need SEO optimization?  
- Do you need Google Analytics or tracking setup?  
- Do you want ongoing maintenance/updates after launch?  
- Any special features (pop-ups, memberships, client portal, etc.)  

---
